turn_prompts: Generate a reproducible task Dockerfile from the approved task design. The frozen environment_policy input is the task contract: decode its canonical JSON and use environment_policy.base_image exactly, unchanged, in every FROM instruction. Do not use tag-only, digest-only, ARG-expanded, substituted, or additional base images. For a non-zero-to-one task, clone the frozen GitHub repository and check out the exact frozen commit without credentials. Never use COPY . ., ADD . ., wildcard task-root sources, external contexts, or broad task-root transfer sources; enumerate only the minimal required files. COPY/ADD --from may reference only an earlier local build-stage alias or numeric index; RUN --mount=from may reference only an earlier local build-stage alias. Do not use ONBUILD or Dockerfile parser directives. Produce only the required structured artifact, then invoke the stage-private harbor_submit_stage_output dynamic tool with it. Do not finish with prose alone; only an accepted tool submission is a stage result.
